limitations.note: The rewrite registers the newly computed count instead of capturing the pre-edge value of `num`, so it misses the intended one-cycle output delay.
The rewrite changes `zero` from low to high during reset and makes it decode the new count rather than the pre-edge count, even though the original `zero` logic needed no change.

The test expects `set_num` to appear on the same edge that loads it and derives the expected `zero` from that value even during reset, so it validates the rewrite’s assumptions rather than checking the intended latency and reset behavior.
The rewrite overlooks the loaded knowledge base’s transferable guidance to preserve output staging and reset behavior when fixing a sequential design.
